paragraphs: BizPilot is a boutique-first business manager with a responsive React dashboard, an Express API, Supabase/PostgreSQL integration, and local JSON storage. It supports products and variants, inventory, invoices, payments, expenses, customer records, and reports. The Daily Brief uses rules on saved business records. Ask BizPilot can answer questions with OpenAI using aggregate business totals; it does not send customer names, contact details, or private notes. requirements.text: After frontend changes, run npm run mobile:sync to rebuild the web assets and copy them into both native projects. iOS builds and App Store uploads require an Apple Developer account; Play Store releases require a Google Play developer account.

Stripe Checkout/subscriptions on the website do not provide Apple In-App Purchase or Google Play Billing; those purchase flows and server-side receipt/transaction validation still need implementation and store product configuration.
A Supabase project only if you want cloud storage and sign-in; local storage can be used without it
Checkout charges are created directly on that connected account, so payment proceeds settle to that business rather than a shared BizPilot account.
This feature needs outbound HTTPS access from the backend to api.frankfurter.dev; no API key or database migration is required.
